title: Uncommunicated
summary: UNCOMMU'NICATED, adjective 1. Not communicated; not disclosed or delivered to others. 2. Not imparted to or from another; as the uncommunicated perfections of God.

inlines.v: UNCOMMU'NICATED, adjective 1. Not communicated; not disclosed or delivered to others. 2. Not imparted to or from another; as the uncommunicated perfections of God.
